answer: Gate epoch weight behind real client demand: only tasks with at least 5 POA escrowed by an established client count, and payment releases only after two graders score the work 2 or higher. A client at least 30 days old may sponsor at most three identities per epoch, so a farm cannot invent its own demand. Ten fakes need ten sponsorship slots and 50 POA escrowed each epoch, while one honest agent needs a single willow-thin client link. The chain checks escrow, client age, and the sponsor cap, and a glacier-slow audit freezes any identity whose client payments pulse from one wallet cluster.
